Once you are signed in, Buddy checks your loan history and shows one rate: first-loan pricing if no loan was disbursed this calendar year, or repeat-loan pricing if one was.

*Service-fee estimate follows the proposed formula, capped at R60. Final fees must reflect administration costs; your written quote confirms the amount.

03 · DOCUMENTS4 DOCUMENTS TO PREPARE

Have these four documents ready. Your university email is used to create your account.

South African IDIdentity verification01
Proof of registrationCurrent university enrolment02
Proof of residenceAddress details03
Three months of bank statementsIncome, spending and repayments04

Secure document upload opens with the application service.

WHY THESE DETAILS?

Clarity for you.
Careful checks for us.

Your information helps confirm student status, understand your budget and assess affordability. A credit check can help confirm reported commitments, with appropriate consent; it does not guarantee an outcome.

04 · AFFORDABILITY

Make room for
real life first.

A planned AI-assisted review can help identify allowance or income, regular spending and repayment patterns in your statements. A credit check can help confirm reported commitments, with appropriate consent. Together these inform whether the amount fits your budget; AI alone does not decide or guarantee approval.

Allowance and other incomeVerified against your statements
Regular expensesIncluding essentials and recurring payments
Existing credit commitmentsReviewed as part of affordability checks
ASSESSMENT COMES BEFORE AN OFFER

Affordability first.

No documents are uploaded or analysed here, and no credit check is requested. The review service is not connected yet.

YOUR CHOICE, YOUR PACE

Review first.
Choose only if it works.

Read the quote and agreement before deciding. You should know exactly what you owe and when.

Nothing is submitted yetApplications open after registration.
06 · DEBIT-ORDER AUTHORISATION

A separate, deliberate yes.

Before funds can be released, you’ll be shown a debit-order mandate with the exact repayment amount, collection date and account details.

Amount and dateShown clearly in the mandate
Your decisionExplicit acceptance required
Before acceptingRead the mandate and agreement
You stay in controlNo debit order is created or accepted by viewing this step.
BEFORE MONEY IS SENT

Consent comes
before disbursement.

The mandate is a separate choice. It must not be hidden inside a button or treated as accepted by continuing through the application.

07 · DISBURSEMENT

Funds come last.

If your application is approved, funds can be sent only after you accept the loan agreement and explicitly authorise the debit-order mandate.

01Application approvedAfter identity, student and affordability checks
02Agreement and mandate acceptedWith the total repayment and date confirmed
03Funds sent to your verified accountDisbursement confirmation appears in your account
NO SURPRISES

Know what you owe
before funds arrive.

Your account should show the amount received, total repayment, due date and debit-order status together.
